card.name: Dash or parenthesis opening an aside
card.fires_on: A dash or opening parenthesis that comes right after a complete noun phrase or clause in news and opinion prose. It marks the start of an aside or added comment.

modes.label: Dash before an aside
modes.description: A hyphen or em dash placed after a noun phrase, introducing an explanation or a continuation.
